intro: I’m Abolfazl, a full-stack developer based in Tehran with a focus on front-end development. I work with React, Next.js, and TypeScript to build product interfaces, admin panels, and brand websites, and implement the server-side APIs and data models behind product workflows. I have a particular interest in motion and interactive 3D experiences.

At Avan Tech, I develop customer and admin workflows across the front end and back end. For Avani’s returns workflow, I defined the data model and implemented the backend APIs alongside the admin and branch interfaces. As co-founder and technical lead at Worldbuilderzzz, I lead end-to-end development of the team’s products and websites. I handled all programming for WePackaging and Fash Ba Tashdid, from the first interaction to individual project pages.

highlights: Developed Avani’s product catalogue and online sales interfaces. Implemented the returns workflow across the stack, from specifications and data modelling to backend APIs and admin and branch panel changes.

Expanded Madar Market’s customer account with wallet withdrawal requests, product returns and tracking, transaction history, notifications, and order cancellation. Improved admin tools for homepage sections and promotions.
Built Talaresoon’s admin interfaces for orders, product variants, customers, categories, and dashboards, and implemented backend routes for product listings and categories used by the mobile client.
Lead end-to-end technical implementation of the team’s products, brand websites, and landing pages, across front-end and back-end development.

contact: I’m open to full-time full-stack and front-end roles, on-site or remote. If your team is hiring, I’d like to hear what you’re building.
